hero.title: Therapeutic massage in College Park, Georgia
hero.subtitle: Melt away tension, ease sore muscles and leave feeling like yourself again. Quiet rooms, clean linens and a relaxed, professional atmosphere.

about.title: A calm place to reset
about.body:
United Massage offers a peaceful space to step out of the day. Whether you want a gentle relaxation session or firmer work on stubborn knots, every visit is tailored to what your body needs.

Tell us where you hold stress and how much pressure you like, and we will take care of the rest.

highlights.title: Tailored pressure
highlights.text: From feather-light to deep, every session is adjusted to you.

highlights.title: Clean & quiet
highlights.text: Fresh linens and a calm, private room for each guest.

highlights.title: Easy payment
highlights.text: We are cash pay. No cards, no surprises.

services.name: Swedish Massage
services.desc: Long, flowing strokes for deep relaxation and better circulation.

services.name: Deep Tissue Massage
services.desc: Slow, firm pressure targeting chronic tension and tight muscle layers.

services.name: Hot Stone Massage
services.desc: Warm stones melt away tightness and help you unwind completely.

services.name: Sports Massage
services.desc: Focused work to support recovery and keep you moving.

services.name: Prenatal Massage
services.desc: Gentle, supportive bodywork for expectant mothers.

services.name: Foot Reflexology
services.desc: Targeted pressure on the feet to relieve fatigue and stress.
